notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
Just uploaded a small patch to make the following changes:

Added on screen objective markers

Made health pickups give full health

Fixed issue with AI getting lazy and just standing there.

tags.balance_change: Made health pickups give full health

tags.bug: Fixed issue with AI getting lazy and just standing there.

notes.title: MULTIPLAYER UPDATE NOW LIVE!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

After a LOT of work, and testing, the multiplayer update is now live!

Enjoy playing with a friend, and have fun in the new map and new destroy the cache game mode!

It's not over yet, a lot more planned for this year so stay tuned!![img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33208220/dffe4a9a8a08475028db29771b4c9786902f29e2.jpg[/img]

tags.feature: - Enjoy playing with a friend, and have fun in the new map and new destroy the cache game mode!

notes.title: New Patch Online
notes.content:
New patch changing a few things,

Adjusted Tesselation distance to stop the texture pop-in

Added more melee damage for when you run out of ammo

Game now pauses when in the Map.
